title: Subitizing: How Many at a Glance?
standard_text: K.2D recognize instantly the quantity of a small group of objects in organized and random arrangements
meta_desc: Free kindergarten subitizing worksheets for Texas TEKS K.2D: see how many at a glance with small groups, dot cubes and ten frames. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: A full row of a ten frame is 5.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Subitizing means seeing how many without counting one by one.
  • Dot cubes and ten frames show numbers in patterns.
  • A full row of a ten frame is 5.
  • See two small groups, then put them together: 3 and 2 make 5.

Examples

Example

A ten frame with 1 full row and 2 more

5 and 2

Answer: 7

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Losing track while countingLook for a pattern you know.
Mixing up 4 and 55 has a dot in the middle.
Adding the parts wrongSee each part, then put them together.
